tool_args.rationale: At a fixed horizon, the coupled linear ODE maps x_now, mem_conv, and u_now to y through just three coefficients. The trajectory batch is the designated probe for adding time-resolved constraints before fitting all four physical parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five rows share H=0.6, so they constrain at most three endpoint coefficients for four ODE parameters.
It cannot explain the observed history gap between endpoint-matched cases.
It is cheaper, but the mechanism notes do not identify it as providing the transient data needed to separate the coupled rates.
It costs the same as the trajectory batch and targets a longer horizon rather than resolving the fast transient at the forecast horizon.
